drills.title: Cone Weave
drills.cue: Head over foot. Outside peg. Steady RPM.
instructions: Weave through the cones, combining head-over-foot alignment, outside-peg weighting, and clutch control at steady RPM.
setupDetails: Start with 9–10 cones in a line. Count and spacing are flexible.
Begin with wide gaps and progressively bring the cones closer together.

drills.title: Moving Outside-Peg Weight
drills.cue: Head over foot. Weight the outside peg.
instructions: While moving, align your head over the outside foot and weight that peg.
Progress toward full steering lock while maintaining the alignment.

drills.title: Collection
drills.cue: Throttle on, throttle off, clutch out, clutch in. Keep the two actions separate.
instructions: Start with the clutch fully pulled in.
Only after the throttle is closed, release the clutch, then pull it fully back in.
Repeat, preserving the separation between throttle input and clutch release.
Practice in motion and stationary with feet on the ground where possible.
setupDetails: Use flat ground. An incline is optional.
